summary: Frontend-only regression test on Display Settings > DISPLAY SCHEDULE TimeStepper. Opened Settings via header gear (settings-button), toggled schedule ON (schedule-toggle), and verified both Start and End TimeStepper controls render and respond correctly. Start went 19:00 -> 19:30 (plus) -> 20:00 (plus) -> 19:30 (minus). End went 07:00 -> 07:30 (plus) -> 07:00 (minus). No ReferenceError, no 'styles is not defined' error, no React Native red screen. Zero console errors captured. Only pre-existing, unrelated deprecation warnings observed: 'textShadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. Previously-flagged bug is NOT reproducible; TimeStepper is functional.

react_native_issues.issue: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Migrate to the shorthand 'textShadow' style. Warning emitted on app load. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SettingsSheet.tsx (and any other places using textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius)
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely coming from an internal library (Modal/Slider). If any app code uses pointerEvents as a prop, migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: No action required for the TimeStepper — it renders and increments/decrements by 30 min correctly for both Start and End with no ReferenceError.
Optional cleanup: migrate textShadow* style props to the new 'textShadow' shorthand in SettingsSheet (and audit repo) to silence deprecation warning.
Optional cleanup: audit codebase for `pointerEvents` used as a prop and move to `style.pointerEvents` to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsSheet.tsx is 1021 lines — consider splitting (TimeStepper, ProfileCard, ScheduleCard, WifiCard, ThemeCard) into separate files to stay under the 700-line guideline.
TimeStepper receives `styles` as a prop from both call sites (lines 417 and 427) which correctly resolves the previously reported 'styles is not defined' ReferenceError; keep as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TimeStepper in SettingsSheet.tsx works. The `styles` prop is passed from both call sites (schedule-start and schedule-end) — no ReferenceError. Only unrelated RN-web deprecation warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents) remain in console. BLE banner ('Bluetooth needs a real device build') is expected in web preview and should be ignored.
rca_of_issue: Previously suspected bug: 'SettingsSheet TimeStepper bare styles ReferenceError'. RCA: TimeStepper is declared as a top-level function outside the SettingsSheet component and therefore cannot close over the `styles` created via useThemedStyles(makeStyles) inside SettingsSheet. The fix already in place is to pass `styles={styles}` as a prop from both call sites (lines 417 and 427) and destructure it in the TimeStepper signature (line 49). Verified via UI test: Start 19:00→19:30→20:00→19:30 and End 07:00→07:30→07:00 with zero ReferenceError.
